In October 2026, the European Medicines Agency (EMA) Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use (CHMP) adopted a positive opinion recommending marketing authorization for daraxonrasib in the European Union (EU) for adults with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma who have received at least one prior systemic therapy.
The CHMP opinion will now be reviewed by the European Commission, which makes decisions on marketing authorization in the EU.

We currently expect to complete enrollment in RASolve 301 by the end of November 2026, to enable an expected clinical readout in 2027; • RASolve 307: evaluating elironrasib in combination with pembrolizumab, pemetrexed and platinum-based chemotherapy in patients with 1L metastatic non-squamous RAS G12C NSCLC in a placebo-controlled study; and • RASolve 308: evaluating zoldonrasib in combination with pembrolizumab and platinum-based chemotherapy in patients with 1L metastatic non-squamous RAS G12D NSCLC in a placebo-controlled study.

Although the FDA has approved our NDA for RASONQUE, we have limited experience submitting NDAs and have only previously submitted one similar application to a comparable foreign regulatory authority, the CHMP, which began evaluating RASONQUE for the treatment of PDAC under a phased review process in July 2026 and adopted a positive opinion recommending marketing authorization for RASONQUE in the EU for adults with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma who have received at least one prior systemic therapy in October 2026.
